name: Three Eras
desc: Three eras at once: a blade stage, pale glass, bright cells.
_note: The mash from design/mockups/nge.html: the blade stage of 2008, the
pale glass of 2009, the bright cells of 2012. It shares the `blades` layout
with nxe, which is the point -- two themes over one layout that do not look
related, because the tokens carry the era and the layout only carries the
shape. Its glass panels are pale over a dark stage, so the accent has to
work at BOTH ends: #3F8F2A clears 3.9:1 on the cells and 4.0:1 on the stage,
where the mockup's own bright gel would vanish on paper and its dark detail
green would vanish on the stage.
